meta.name: skill-system-governance
meta.description: Audit and optimize a skill system with evidence. Use for skill architecture, token or context waste, role and prompt boundaries, routing hits or misfires, plugin packaging, registry/docs/source drift, duplicate workflows, or deciding whether a reusable change belongs in a skill. Runs deterministic checks first and applies only authorized, minimal fixes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计并优化技能系统的架构与运行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在管理或维护一个技能系统，需要发现并修复问题。
copy.tagline_en: Audit and optimize your skill system architecture and operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage or maintain a skill system and need to find and fix issues.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先对技能系统做只读审计，检查架构、路由、上下文浪费等问题，然后给出是否修改的结论。只有你明确授权，它才会执行最小改动。
howto.when: 当你询问技能系统的架构、路由命中率、文档与源码是否一致，或想判断某个改动是否应归入技能时触发。

say.text: 审计一下当前技能系统的路由命中率。
say.note: Claude 会运行确定性检查并报告路由准确性。

say.text: 检查技能文档和源码是否有差异。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude audits the skill system read-only, checking architecture, routing, context waste, etc., then produces a verdict. Only if you authorize optimization does it apply minimal fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about skill architecture, routing hit rate, registry/docs/source drift, or whether a change belongs in a skill.

say_en.text: Audit the routing hit rate of the current skill system.
say_en.note: Claude runs deterministic checks and reports routing accuracy.

say_en.text: Check for drift between skill docs and source code.
say_en.note: Claude compares registry, docs, and source to find inconsistencies.
